This '''Separatist headquarters''' was a building in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Chaleydonia/Legends|Crystal City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Christophsis/Legends|Christophsis]].<ref name="the" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline">{{TCWdates|116}}</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it was occupied by [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="the" /> A [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|duel]] also took place there, shortly after [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] came to investigate evidence of a traitor.<ref name="the" />
